source_tsv_parser: csv.QUOTE_NONE matching source loader; corrected before any CV17 teacher training or test evaluation
features: wav2vec2-base revision0b5b8e868dd84f03fd87d01f9c4ff0f080fecfe8; float32; mono16k; normalize real waveform before fixed12s padding; final-layer valid-frame mean; no attention mask
feature_normalization: StandardScaler fit only to permitted auxiliary examples within each seed, followed by per-example unit L2 norm; save mean/scale
teacher: linear768to3, Balanced Softmax with auxiliary counts
accountant: Opacus PRV, actual Poisson sample rate and all80epochs; per teacher condition, not a joint release guarantee
optimization_choice_basis: separate earlier CV archive development-only seed0 non-DP check over LR .003/.01/.03 and80epochs, no CV17 outcome tuning
checkpoint_selection: maximum selection-split Macro-F1, earliest ties; calibration never selects checkpoints
meanmatched_control: constant KL weight alpha times mean_aux(sum_k softmax(teacher_logits/T)_k * calibration_recall_k), isolating instance adaptation from average attenuation; no test input
uniform_hakd: exact KD objective, paired state reused after loss/gradient equivalence test; not counted as independent trained branch
ctkd: verified published global temperature: T=1+20sigmoid(u), u0=1, cosine10epoch gradient reversal
health_uncertainty: 2000 speaker-cluster bootstrap draws on independent calibration; compare original multinomial estimator, do not claim utility guarantee
heldout_region_check: compare fixed calibration routes/certificates with the empirical test-health region; report finite-test-proxy disagreements, not population coverage or student-risk guarantees; never use test health to select routes
student_baseline_route: S-BAcc selects Hard/KD/HAKD on selection split, ties in that order
incremental_prediction: leave-one-seed-out standardized ridge(alpha1) of KD-Hard gain using BAcc alone, composite alone, and all3components; compare held-out squared errors; descriptive correlations secondary
uncertainty_reporting: paired seed summaries; noise levels are repeated conditions, not independent seeds; no pooling with different datasets or earlier archive
negative_result_action: retain full grid; simplify claims if composite or attenuation has no demonstrated incremental value; no selection by test outcomes
